relational_hope: Make declared temporal assumptions inspectable before their outputs are trusted.

mechanisms.title: Typed Markov reward profile
mechanisms.hypothesis: The complete bounded two-state profile has a unique exact rational normalization.

mechanisms.title: Positive transition support
mechanisms.hypothesis: Exactly the strictly positive transition entries define the declared directed support.

mechanisms.title: One-step probability transport
mechanisms.hypothesis: The initial row distribution multiplied by the transition matrix retains total mass one.

mechanisms.title: Finite transition powers
mechanisms.hypothesis: The declared finite power includes an exact identity at horizon zero and remains stochastic.

mechanisms.title: Finite distribution propagation
mechanisms.hypothesis: The complete propagated distribution equals the initial distribution times the finite transition power.

mechanisms.title: Transient expected reward trace
mechanisms.hypothesis: Each finite trace row binds its distribution to that row's exact expected reward.

mechanisms.title: Finite discounted reward sum
mechanisms.hypothesis: The frozen finite sum respects zero horizon and the time-zero term when discount is zero.

mechanisms.title: Whole stationary-distribution family
mechanisms.hypothesis: The identity transition retains every stationary mixture; other two-state profiles retain the exact unique stationary vector.

mechanisms.title: Closed communicating classes
mechanisms.hypothesis: Support determines closed classes and transient states without inventing irreducibility.

mechanisms.title: Two-state contraction and periodicity
mechanisms.hypothesis: The exact second eigenvalue distinguishes unique convergence, the periodic flip and stationary nonuniqueness.

mechanisms.title: Exact discounted value equation
mechanisms.hypothesis: The two-state rational resolvent solves the fixed-transition Bellman equation for discount below one.

mechanisms.title: Residual-based value enclosure
mechanisms.hypothesis: A supplied value probe has an exact residual and a valid sup-norm error bound.

mechanisms.title: Normalized discounted occupancy
mechanisms.hypothesis: The discounted occupancy vector retains unit mass and the complete flow identity.

mechanisms.title: Finite-return tail certificate
mechanisms.hypothesis: The exact finite return differs from the infinite discounted return by no more than the declared geometric tail bound.

mechanisms.title: Fixed-chain potential transformation
mechanisms.hypothesis: Adding discounted next-potential minus current potential changes the fixed-chain value by minus the potential.

mechanisms.title: Constant reward translation
mechanisms.hypothesis: A constant reward translation changes every discounted state value by the exact geometric multiplier.

mechanisms.title: Discount sensitivity with fixed inputs
mechanisms.hypothesis: The exact derivative holds transition, reward and initial distribution fixed and does not establish empirical responsiveness.

mechanisms.title: Structured value-coordinate projection
mechanisms.hypothesis: Exact state-discount-value rows remain available independently of a visual projection and do not establish complete accessibility.

mechanisms.title: Missing observation and identification evidence
mechanisms.hypothesis: Declared transition probabilities and rewards do not supply observations, sampling protocols or independent model validation.

mechanisms.title: Real-action authority reservation
mechanisms.hypothesis: A successful finite computation cannot execute a governed real-world action or establish outside authority.
